note: BLM recreation site on Holter Lake (Missouri River), part of the Holter Lake/Log Gulch/Departure Point complex near Wolf Creek, managed by the Butte Field Office. Campsites are on the paved upper lot; fee season May 1 to mid-October. Drinking water at Log Gulch, about 1/4 mile away. --Claude
